subject: Key lineage & HSM validation request for SOC2
messages:
From: Elena Martin <elena.martin@greenbridge.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.example>
Cc: securityteam@greenbridge.com
Date: 2028-06-06T14:12:00Z
Subject: Request: key lineage + HSM validation for SOC2 review

Hi Olga,

We're preparing for an upcoming SOC 2 review and need a compact bundle showing Redwood's key management controls for the tenant integration with GreenBridge. Specifically we need:
- Key lineage (aliases -> CMK IDs) for tenant keys used to encrypt customer data
- Key rotation history (audit log or export) covering Jan 2025 -> present
- HSM cert chain / FIPS attestation used for any HSM-backed KEKs
- Short description of at-rest encryption architecture and where keys are stored (KMS vs customer BYOK)

Can you provide a snapshot of these artifacts or point us to a secure location where we can download them? Ideally we can have something by EOD Wednesday (2028-06-07). If you need to redact tenant IDs, that's fine — we just need proof of rotation cadence and HSM binding.

Thanks,
Elena Martin
Senior InfoSec Manager
GreenBridge Financial
From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.example>
To: Elena Martin <elena.martin@greenbridge.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.example>
Date: 2028-06-06T15:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: key lineage + HSM validation for SOC2 review

Elena — thanks for the clear list. We're on it. Quick notes:
- We can produce a key alias -> CMK export and a consolidated rotation log CSV covering the date range you gave.
- HSM cert chain (PEM) and vendor attestation (FIPS version) are available; we'll include the certificate chain and a short HSM vendor statement.
- For at-rest architecture, I'll include a 1-page diagram + plain-language summary (KMS envelope encryption, KEKs wrapped by HSM).

Two quick questions:
1) Do you need the logs with tenant identifiers redacted, or is GreenBridge OK with full identifiers?
2) Would you like the artifacts delivered as a secured Drive folder or via your SFTP? We can do either.

Targeting delivery by EOD Wed (2028-06-07). I'll loop in Jonas to pull exports and Rachel to confirm BYOK notes.

Thanks — Olga
Olga Petrov
Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
olga@redwood.example
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.example>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.example>, Elena Martin <elena.martin@greenbridge.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.example>
Date: 2028-06-06T17:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: key lineage + HSM validation for SOC2 review

Elena / Olga — I've pulled the initial exports. Attachments (placeholders) I'll stage to a secure Drive link: https://drive.redwood.example/s/gb-keystore-20280606 (access granted to elena.martin@greenbridge.com).

Files prepared:
- keystore_snapshot_20280606.csv  (columns: alias, cmk_id, created_at, key_policy_summary)
- rotation_log_202501-202806.csv  (columns: cmk_id, rotation_event_ts, actor, change_type, comment)
- hsm_cert_chain.pdf  (PEM chain + vendor attestation summary)
- byok_handover_instructions.md  (step-by-step for BYOK handover and wrap/unwrapping)

Notes / caveats:
- The rotation log includes system-initiated automatic rotations and manual rewrap events. We can redact tenant-specific aliases on request — currently the export contains tenant aliases for traceability.
- We also have secure audit exports (CloudKMS audit log) but those are larger; let us know if you need full CloudKMS audit event blobs.

HubSpot ticket: HBSP-4521 (linked).

Jonas
Senior Platform Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Elena Martin <elena.martin@greenbridge.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.example>, Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.example>
Date: 2028-06-06T19:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: key lineage + HSM validation for SOC2 review

Thanks Jonas — Drive link works. A few clarifications from the reviewer: 

- Please confirm rotation cadence (automatic rotate every X months? manual only?). We need an explicit statement to include in the SOC 2 control narrative.
- For the HSM certs: can you confirm vendor name and FIPS level (e.g., FIPS 140-2 Level 2/3/4)?
- BYOK: we need a short clause that explains whether customer-managed keys are ever exported from an HSM in plaintext and the handoff process.

If you can add a 1-2 sentence signed statement from Redwood stating these points, that will be enough for the auditor.

Elena
From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.example>
To: Elena Martin <elena.martin@greenbridge.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.example>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.example>
Date: 2028-06-07T09:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: key lineage + HSM validation for SOC2 review

Elena — attaching the requested artifacts to the Drive folder and summarizing the statements for your auditor below. The Drive folder contains the four files Jonas listed. I've also exported a one-page control narrative PDF into the same folder ("kms_control_narrative_20280607.pdf").

Signed summary statements for inclusion in your SOC 2 package:
1) Rotation cadence: "Redwood Inference enforces automatic key rotation for system-managed CMKs on a 12-month cadence. Manual rotation or rewraps may occur for operational reasons; all rotation events are logged in the rotation_log CSV and are traceable to an actor and timestamp."

2) HSM / FIPS: "Redwood's KEK wrapping is performed using vendor HSM appliances (Thales Luna SA / nShield equivalent depending on region) validated to FIPS 140-2 Level 3 or higher. The provided hsm_cert_chain.pdf contains the PEM certificate chain and the vendor attestation snapshot."

3) BYOK export policy: "Customer-supplied keys (BYOK) are accepted and wrapped by Redwood's HSMs. Redwood does not export customer keys in plaintext from the HSM. The byok_handover_instructions.md describes the steps to import and verify key wrapping; any handoff that requires key material movement must follow an approved secure transport process and be documented in a joint handoff ticket."

If you'd like, I can produce a short (signed) cover letter on Redwood letterhead that the auditor can retain. Let me know if any redaction is required in the CSVs and we'll produce a redacted copy.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
T: +1 415-555-0198
olga@redwood.example

Attachments in Drive: keystore_snapshot_20280606.csv, rotation_log_202501-202806.csv, hsm_cert_chain.pdf, byok_handover_instructions.md, kms_control_narrative_20280607.pdf
